verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform, so background automations are a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no feature for setting up autonomous or scheduled automations. Triggers only let MCP servers push upstream events to consumers. That is a developer building block, not a user-configurable automation runner, and the hosted connection services were shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
